name: Shimizu Erika
source:
A lesbian. She's [url=https://vndb.org/c7776]Yuri's[/url] domestic partner and lover. She hates the idea of her girlfriend having sex with a boy and only put up with it for the promise of a baby they can share together. Yuri tries to convince her to have sex with Seiichiro so she can become pregnant too.

Her 'favorite number' is 27
